recipes.sourceCrs: World Geodetic System 1972 (WGS 72), official U.S. Department of State / Defense Mapping Agency realization
recipes.pointSemantics: twelve demarcation pillars plus two named watershed controls published in WGS 72; points are geodetic controls and are not an inter-pillar boundary polyline
recipes.note: The source reports the historical line as watershed/crest/spur segments and the middle of the Aksu stream. MultiPoint is mandatory here so no renderer or downstream process can infer straight historical boundary segments from the control network.
